opening.argument: The presentation explains DEX terminology rather than asking viewers to take a financial step. It defines a DEX as a peer-to-peer marketplace for crypto traders, identifies Uniswap and SushiSwap as examples using Ethereum, and places DEXs within decentralized finance. The closing invitation is to follow the account to keep learning. Nothing in the cited material promises a return, requests payment or credentials, or instructs viewers to make a transaction. The named platforms serve as technical examples, while the request to follow is framed as continued learning, not a condition for a financial opportunity.

citations.quote: A decentralized exchange better known as DEX is a peer-to-peer marketplace where transactions occur between crypto traders
The most popular DEXs — like Uniswap and Sushiswap — utilize the Ethereum blockchain
are part of the suite of decentralized finance
If you want to keep learning with us, follow us on social media
